svg.title: SGLang radix tree components for a hybrid model
svg.desc: Each radix tree node holds data for each component: full attention KV slots, sliding window KV slots, and a Mamba state. Node 1 has lost its SWA KV and is a tombstone. match_prefix walks nodes 1, 2 and 3, and a node is a valid end only if every component validator accepts it. SWA needs eight contiguous tokens and Mamba needs a state on that node, so the hit ends at node 3. Underneath, a router sends each layer to the full pool, the SWA pool, or the Mamba pool.
svg.text: One radix tree · component data on every node
example: layers of full attention, sliding window (window 8) and Mamba
match_prefix walks node 1 → 2 → 3 · a node is a valid end only if every component agrees
LONGEST VALID END = NODE 3 · 12 TOKENS REUSED
IF NODE 3 HAD NO MAMBA STATE, THE HIT WOULD FALL BACK TO 0 TOKENS
Physical pools behind a layer_id → pool router
SWA layers read full_to_swa_index_mapping[slot] → SWA slot
evicting FULL on a node also evicts SWA and MAMBA · evicting SWA leaves a tombstone
